story_overview: Ryan has a pleasant encounter with Vince at a gas station, but later at home, his drinking worries Dolores and Carol. At a lively party, Ryan remains pensive while friends like Tony and Dolores celebrate. The story ends with Ryan and Carol having a quiet conversation in a crowded pub.
